about:
Carolina Woodworks operates from Lyman, South Carolina, in the Upstate region. The family-owned shop draws on more than 30 years of hands-on experience and multi-generational woodworking knowledge, with a background in custom home building that informs its approach to cabinetry and millwork.

The company designs, builds, finishes, and installs fully custom cabinetry, built-ins, vanities, entertainment walls, commercial millwork, and architectural details. Every project is fabricated in-house using premium materials, BLUM soft-close hardware, dovetailed drawer boxes, and professional lacquer finishes. The shop works across frameless, face-frame, inset, and multiple overlay cabinet configurations.

Carolina Woodworks serves homeowners, builders, remodelers, interior designers, and commercial clients throughout the Upstate. Its portfolio includes custom kitchens, bathrooms, built-in shelving, entertainment centers, office suites, and pantry systems for both residential and commercial spaces.

The firm emphasizes exact-design flexibility—building each piece around the home's architecture rather than a catalog—along with technical range that covers multiple cabinet styles under one roof. Furniture-grade execution, precision joinery, specialized finishes, and direct client communication with visible progress are cited as core differentiators.
